from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityCDSReport(BaseModel):
    """A Common Data Set (CDS) report entry for a single university."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    out_of_state_freshmen_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of first-time first-year students from out of state (Section F1)")
    admitted_first_year_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time first-year students admitted (Section C1)")
    enrolled_first_year_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time first-year students enrolled (Section C1)")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The academic or reporting period (e.g. 'Fall 2021')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_reports: list[UniversityCDSReport]
